name: Gainwell Technologies (Partner)
desc:
Medicaid Agent | $29,100-$41,600/yr | Inbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: Gainwell Technologies
Industry: Healthcare IT / Medicaid Management Services
What Your Day Will Look Like:
Gainwell handles Medicaid management for state governments, and in this role you'd be the friendly, knowledgeable voice supporting Oklahoma's Medicaid program specifically. You'd answer inbound calls from customers with questions about their healthcare services and benefits, research their situation using internal systems and job aids, and document everything accurately. Since this touches real people's healthcare and personal information, following HIPAA and privacy procedures on every call is a core part of the job, not an afterthought. This is a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment with back-to-back calls, so it rewards someone who stays calm and organized under a steady volume.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not explicitly stated in posting.
Required Experience: At least one year of experience in a high-volume call center or contact center environment.
Preferred Experience: Healthcare, Medicaid, health insurance, or related experience is a plus, not required.
Required Skills:
Strong verbal communication, active listening, and customer service skills
Solid problem-solving ability
Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems while researching and documenting
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment with back-to-back calls
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with at least a year of call center experience who's comfortable with steady, back-to-back call volume
Someone detail-oriented and comfortable following strict privacy and confidentiality procedures
Someone who wants healthcare-adjacent experience without needing prior Medicaid or insurance background
An Oklahoma-based participant, since residency is preferred, though not required, for this specific Oklahoma Medicaid program role
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone without at least a year of call center or high-volume customer service experience
Anyone who can't meet the internet speed requirement, 150 Mbps minimum with a wired Ethernet connection is stricter than most postings in this database
Anyone uncomfortable with on-camera interviews and a full first week of on-camera orientation
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Inbound call handling
Healthcare and benefits support
HIPAA and confidentiality compliance
Customer research and documentation
High-volume contact center experience
Active listening
Problem-solving under pressure
Multi-system navigation
Metrics and quality standards
Professional phone communication
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Application → Assessment → Phone screen → Final interview. Total time to hire averages 3 to 15 days. Note: this posting is intended for pipelining, meaning Gainwell accepts applications on an ongoing basis rather than for one specific start date.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience in a high-volume call center or contact center environment.
How do you stay accurate and calm when handling back-to-back calls all day?
Walk us through how you'd protect a customer's sensitive healthcare information during a call.
What's your comfort level researching an answer across multiple systems while still talking with the customer?
How do you handle a call that needs to be escalated because it's beyond what you can resolve?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $29,100 to $41,600 per year, varying by geographic region, internal equity, and experience.
Shift: Work schedule based on business and operational needs. Specific hours not detailed in posting, confirm directly.
Benefits: Generous, flexible vacation policy, 401(k) employer match, comprehensive health benefits, educational assistance, and access to leadership and technical development academies.
Equipment Provided: Not stated in posting. Participant is responsible for a wired Ethernet connection with a minimum internet speed of 150 Mbps, one of the stricter internet requirements in this database.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated. Given this is a government Medicaid contractor, background requirements are typically strict, worth screening participants for any disqualifying history early.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: This is a genuinely solid, stable placement given Gainwell's government Medicaid contract work and full benefits package. Video cameras are required for interviews and the entire first week of orientation, worth prepping a participant for that upfront. Oklahoma residency is preferred but not required, which is a nice flexibility point if a participant later relocates. This posting is a standing pipeline listing, so there's no application deadline pressure.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting. Reasonable inferred path: Call Center Representative → Senior Representative → Team Lead → Quality Assurance Specialist, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by Gainwell directly.
training: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM CST for 2 weeks.
